description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training loss and FLOPs for different methods relative to a Vanilla method. The x-axis is labeled “FLOPs (10^12)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are five lines displayed on the plot. The first line, representing “Vanilla”, is solid, blue, and begins at approximately (0, 100) and ends at approximately (80, 100), maintaining a constant value. The second line, representing “Sep1LM (n=380)”, is solid, red, and begins at approximately (0, 72.19) and ends at approximately (80, 65.72), showing a decline. The third line, representing “Sep1LM (n=256)”, is dashed, red, and begins at approximately (0, 69.67) and ends at approximately (80, 62.10), also showing a decline. The fourth line, representing “Sep1LM (n=64)”, is dash-dot, red, and begins at approximately (0, 77.18) and ends at approximately (80, 72.19), showing a decline. The fifth line, representing “Sep1LM(n=8)”, is dotted, red, and begins at approximately (0, 19.62) and ends at approximately (80, 25.48), showing an increase.
